purpose: Sprint15 closeout replan: deploy the merged development tip to bmcam003 + bmcam004 (both Trixie/NetworkManager), bench-verify the video pipeline on each, arm continuous HIL. Replaces the deferred bmcam000 HIL morning review (bmcam000 reformatted to Trixie by Nick the same morning).

bmcam003.optics: manual focus lens 1.82, AWB/exposure auto (unit stills keys, inherited)

bmcam004.optics: camera_controls_enabled=false (full auto; unit stills keys, inherited)

config.power_halt: disabled/dry-run on both units (bench-safe; potted units must not self-halt)
config.storage_ring: max_used_pct 75 / min_free_gb 10, ~107 GB free at start

bench_evidence.per_unit: 4 consecutive 15 s clips (clip_minutes 0.25, session_minutes 1), all complete triples (mp4 + thumb + sidecar), manifest 4 entries, zero .part/.tmp debris, clean session end, no halt
bench_evidence.ffprobe: h264 1000x562, ~14.4-14.5 s per 15 s nominal clip

hil_evidence.verified: both units: .part growing, gallery 200, manifest.json 200, Range request 206, cron log shows continuous session

notes: Sofar 'vid' status rows not expected: bench units, plain cron path sends over UART only when a transmitting Spotter hosts the unit; morning review of this HIL owns that check.

Sidecar size differs between units (963 B vs 577 B) because bmcam003 carries requested_controls detail (manual focus) while bmcam004 has camera_controls_enabled=false — per-unit stills-key drift, by design.
wap/AP rehearsal deferred: network_ap.sh is Bullseye-stack (hostapd) and needs an nmcli rewrite for Trixie (tracker section 6, TODO-BM-012).
